subject: Goodwill credit request — KV cache regression impacting Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna@nimbushealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Sudden billing spike — can we get a credit?

Hi Stephanie,

Ops flagged a sharp increase in token usage starting Feb 12 after we upgraded to the latest routing bundle. Attached is a small CSV with daily token counts and the billing spike lines (billing_spike_csv.csv). Our monthly spend estimate jumped ~3x for the affected cohort. Can you confirm whether this is on our side or something on Redwood? If this is a platform regression, we need to talk credits — this invoice is material for us.

How quickly can your team investigate? We have an internal renewal review next week.

Thanks,
Jenna Park
Director, Platform Engineering
Nimbus Health

--
Attachment: billing_spike_csv.csv
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T11:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sudden billing spike — can we get a credit?

Hi Jenna — thanks for flagging and for the CSV. I’m escalating this immediately. I’ve looped in Markus (eng) and Naomi (CS/revenue ops) so we can get a fast root-cause and a proposed remediation (including a goodwill credit if warranted).

Short term: would you be open to us provisioning a provisional one-time credit while we investigate? We can formalize the amount after Markus confirms the impact window and token-level delta. If you can share the last invoice number and the HubSpot renewal contact, that helps speed approvals.

I’ll update you within 24 hours with a cause estimate and a proposed credit range.

Appreciate the quick heads-up — we want to make this right.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T12:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sudden billing spike — can we get a credit? — Root cause summary

Stephanie / team — quick tech note after initial triage: we believe this is a KV-cache hit rate regression triggered by the model routing change rolled 2027-02-12. Routing altered cache keys for a small subset of customer traffic; cache miss rates jumped from ~78% to ~5% for Nimbus’ workload, which explains the token increase. Impact window is roughly Feb 12 02:00 UTC — Feb 14 08:00 UTC.

Attached is a short root-cause (kv_cache_rootcause_summary.pdf) with the metrics and the exact token delta we observed. The fix is a configuration rollback + small routing patch; we can ship a targeted deploy within ~24 hours and full verification in 48 hours.

Recommendation: offer a one-time goodwill credit tied to the excess tokens during the impact window (we should exclude legitimate traffic growth). I attached the postmortem link for reference.

-Markus
Principal SW Engineer, Serving Runtime
Markus_Klein@redwood.com

--
Attachment: kv_cache_rootcause_summary.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-15T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Goodwill credit calc needed / finance code

Team — based on Markus’ numbers I ran a draft calc and put it in proposed_goodwill_calc.xlsx (attached). Two options:

- One-time credit equal to the excess token invoice lines for the impact window (recommended, faster to approve).
- Short-term discount (e.g., 30% off next invoice) if the customer prefers smoothing.

Estimated one-time credit: $95,000 (range $82k–$110k depending on filtering of legitimate usage). We need an exec approval to commit >$50k. Please confirm the precise invoice line items to reconcile. Also confirm the finance GL code to post the credit and whether Legal needs a note in the contract amendment.

If the customer wants a longer-term concession we’ll need Sales + Legal to approve terms; that’s slower. For now, recommend the one-time credit and an apology note from Stephanie + a short technical summary from Markus.

-Laura
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

--
Attachment: proposed_goodwill_calc.xlsx
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-15T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval needed for Nimbus — quick advocate note

Folks — adding a short commercial perspective: Nimbus is high-touch strategic customer (DL-3829 pipeline, annual ARR $2.4M). This is timing-critical: they have their renewal review on Feb 20 and are nervous about platform stability. Offering a clean one-time credit + postmortem will preserve the relationship and avoid discount creep.

I recommend we request executive sign-off for up to $95k one-time goodwill credit, with the condition that we complete the fix and share the postmortem within 5 business days. If the execs prefer a different number, I can negotiate down to $60k but we should avoid anything below $50k without higher escalation.

Aditya Rao
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: CEO Execs <execs@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-16T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: ACTION: Executive approval request — up to $95k goodwill credit for Nimbus (DL-3829)

Team — request an approval decision for the Nimbus Health situation. Short summary:
- Impact: KV-cache key regression caused elevated token usage for Nimbus (impact window Feb 12–14).
- Tech status: fix deployed to routing layer; verification in progress (Markus).
- Customer: Nimbus Health, renewal review Feb 20 (deal DL-3829).
- Proposed remediation: one-time goodwill credit to cover excess token charges for the impact window; recommended amount $95,000 (Laura’s calc).

Decision requested: approve a one-time credit up to $95k (yes/no). If approved, revenue ops will post the credit and I will send the customer the apology + postmortem.

Please reply to this thread with a short approval (e.g., "Approve" or "Decline") or ask for a brief sync. If no response by EOD tomorrow we will escalate to the GTM leadership call.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
